sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October (KO 15:00) in what should be a straightforward assignment. Sandbach sit top with 22 points from 10 games and are in excellent form with five consecutive wins, while Alsager Town are struggling at the foot of the table with just 4 points from 10 matches and have lost their last four games.
divisionWide: Stafford Town, second and just two points behind leaders Sandbach, face an away trip to Dawley Town — a match that could prove significant in the title race. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, host Eccleshall in what is a meeting of two mid-table contenders; Eccleshall occupy fifth place with 18 points. Wolverhampton Casuals (fourth, 19 points) are at home to Wednesfield Community in another fixture with playoff implications. In-form Bilston Town (sixth, 17 points) and Barnton (seventh, 15 points) face each other at Foley Meir and Shawbury United respectively. New Mills, in mid-table, travel to Market Drayton Town in a battle of struggling sides, while Brereton Social play host to Widnes Town — Widnes are in desperate form at the bottom with just 2 points. Crewe's home fixture against Allscott Heath pits two teams in the lower reaches of the division.
